newsitem.title: USA: US late spot heat retreats, gasoline diffs mixed.
newsitem.headline: US late spot heat retreats, gasoline diffs mixed.

text.p: U.S. spot distillate prices Thursday gave back the majority of their sharp gains from Wednesday's futures rally while gasoline ended mostly lower tracking NYMEX, players said.

Concerns about warmer-weather forecasts for the East Coast next week prompted futures traders to bid down February heating oil 1.50 cents a gallon, a retreat from yesterday's 2.0 cent rally, traders said.

Differentials on New York heating oil were a tad weaker at 0.10 cent above the February print, while Gulf Coast diffs eased about 0.25 cent to 5.15 cents under the print for front -second-cycle material.

"Gulf Coast No. 2 and low sulfur diesel weakened probably due to Colonial Pipeline extending their proration through February," one Gulf trader said, speaking of the distillate line from Houston to New York Harbor.
Conventional unleaded gasoline saw diffs firm moderately in both centers, more than offsetting a 0.16 cent per gallon decline in February futures.
But differentials on New York Harbor reformulated "A5" grade held steady at about 0.75 cent below the print, players said.
